PMF.toReal_nonneg: The real probability mass p(a) of any individual outcome a is nonnegative.
PMF.toReal_le_one: The real probability mass p(a) of any individual outcome a is at most one.
PMF.sum_toReal: On a finite alphabet, the sum of all real atom masses of a probability law p is one.
PMF.bind_toReal_apply: For a law p on a finite input alphabet and a channel f, the real output mass at b is ∑ₐ p(a) f(b|a).
PMF.supportFinset: On a finite alphabet, the finite support of p consists of exactly the outcomes a with p(a) ≠ 0.
PMF.mem_supportFinset: An outcome a belongs to the enumerated finite support of p exactly when it belongs to its ordinary support.
PMF.coe_supportFinset: Viewed as a set, the enumerated finite support of p equals its ordinary support.
PMF.supportFinset_card: The number of outcomes in the enumerated finite support equals the cardinality of the support set of p.
PMF.supportFinset_nonempty: Every probability law on a finite alphabet gives positive mass to at least one outcome.
PMF.eq_pure_iff_support_eq_singleton: A discrete law p is the point mass at a if and only if its support is the singleton {a}.
PMF.map_apply_of_injective: If f is injective, the pushforward of p assigns mass p(a) to f(a) for each a.
PMF.map_apply_eq_zero_of_notMem_range: If b is outside the range of f, then the pushforward of p by f assigns zero mass to b.
PMF.map_apply_equiv: Under a bijective relabeling e, the mass of e(a) in the relabeled law equals the original mass of a.
